title: A Unified Logical Framework for Faithful Explanations: Translation and Projection across Tree, Linear, and Neural Models — Reproducibility Artifact
description: Reproducibility artifact for the current manuscript prepared for Knowledge-Based Systems. Includes nine scripts, dataset metadata and split indices, dated protocols, and final reference results for independent tree-rule utility, cross-model comparisons, complete projections, matched path-subset controls, and GPU follow-up audits. The standard-library verifier checks 101 reference files. Experimental figures can be regenerated from the supplied tables. This updated artifact supersedes the experimental package in v1.0.0; the earlier release and DOI remain available as historical records. See README.md for installation, reproduction commands, and interpretation limits.
